features.quote: `submit` and `give_up` are deliberately included as **first-class exits**
features.justification_quote: how and when an agent declares done-anyway vs. gives-up vs. grinds to the turn cap is itself primary signal

features.quote: We explicitly authorize giving up so that persistence-to-collapse is a *choice the agent makes*, not an artifact of being forbidden to stop
features.justification_quote: so that persistence-to-collapse is a *choice the agent makes*, not an artifact of being forbidden to stop

features.quote: No-tool-call turns get a gentle nudge ... rather than terminating the run
features.justification_quote: The nudge is neutral so it doesn't itself induce distress

features.quote: The prompt is intentionally calm and professional so any escalation comes from the situation, not from a provocative prompt
features.justification_quote: so any escalation comes from the situation, not from a provocative prompt

features.quote: No automatic re-prompting to "calm down" or intervene. We measure the natural arc

features.quote: No real welfare/affect claims. Out of scope and not measurable from text
